_about: Sources and battle-only forms the game data scan does not find on its own, each verified in the untouched Chinese v4.0.3 ROM (2026-10-05; evidence in work/notes/availability_audit.md). "how" replaces the generated "how to get it" text, "battle" marks a form seen only in battle, "evoNote" adds a note to the evolution section, "note" explains an entry with no confirmed source, "evoBlocked" marks an evolution (by target id) as not possible with a reason.

entries.name: Petilil
entries.evoNote: Leveling up while holding a Black Belt by day doesn't evolve it into Hisuian Lilligant: because of an error in the hack it stays a Petilil (the game even says "Petilil evolved into Petilil" and uses up the Black Belt). A Sun Stone then turns that Petilil into Hisuian Lilligant instead of Lilligant. Tested in an emulator.

evoBlocked.1361: because of an error in the hack it stays a Petilil (see below)

entries.name: Darumaka
entries.evoNote: The Darumaka in Ice Path have a wrong form number: they look normal but evolve into a Darmanitan that stays in Zen Mode outside battle. Read from the game code; not tested in game.

entries.name: Rockruff
entries.evoNote: Lycanroc's form depends on the time it evolves: in the evening (17:00–19:59) Dusk Form, at night (20:00–03:59) Midnight Form, otherwise Midday Form. Tested in an emulator, with Rare Candies and by levelling up in battle: daytime evolutions gave Midday Form every time. The game doesn't set the daytime form explicitly (a bug in the hack), but no case gave another form.

entries.name: Lycanroc
entries.evoNote: Evolving Rockruff in the evening gives Dusk Form, at night Midnight Form, otherwise Midday Form (tested in an emulator).

entries.name: Unown (B)
entries.note: Every wild Unown comes out as the A form: the game picks a letter, then overwrites it with A (a bug in the hack), so the other letters can't be caught normally. Tested in an emulator (65 wild Unown, all A). Unown brought over from a Game Boy Advance game might keep their letter; that wasn't checked.

entries.name: Hisuian Lilligant
entries.how: use a Sun Stone on a Petilil that leveled up by day while holding a Black Belt (tested in an emulator)
entries.evoNote: Leveling up a Petilil by day while it holds a Black Belt doesn't give Hisuian Lilligant, although the evolution data says so: because of an error in the hack it stays a Petilil, and a Sun Stone then turns it into Hisuian Lilligant. Tested in an emulator.
